Help

How do I choose a summary template?

Open a recording that has no summary yet, tap the template button in its Summary tab, pick one of nine templates and tap Generate Summary. Choosing a template and generating is part of Verbi Pro; on the free plan, your first transcript gets one summary automatically, with your default template.

Free to download, with 60 minutes of transcription every month.

Last updated: October 24, 2026

How do I pick a template and generate the summary?

  1. Open the recording and go to its Summary tab.
  2. Tap the template button. Choose Summary Template opens with the nine templates.
  3. Pick a template, then tap Generate Summary.

With Pro, you often don’t need to: Verbi writes a summary on its own after every transcript of 200 characters or more, with the recording’s template, which is your default.

Which nine templates are there?

TemplateWhat it’s for
General MeetingAn overview, each topic discussed, decisions and follow-ups.
1:1 MeetingFeedback, commitments and action items from a one-on-one.
Daily MeetingProgress, blockers and next steps from a daily stand-up.
Weekly MeetingWeekly priorities, metrics and longer-term action items.
Lesson NotesCore ideas, explanations and study reminders from a class.
Idea CaptureThe core idea, supporting details and possible next steps.
Email DraftA professional email draft built from the recording.
Action ItemsAll tasks, owners and deadlines as a checklist.
Blog PostA blog post with an introduction, a main body and a conclusion.

Default template, free plan and other rules

  • Default: when you first set up Verbi, it asks what you’ll use it for, and your answer sets the default template. Without an answer, the default is General Meeting. Each new recording uses the default.
  • Free plan: one automatic summary, on your first transcript of 200 characters or more, with the default template. If it fails, it isn’t used up. After that, Generate Summary shows “Pro Feature: Upgrade to Verbi Pro to generate AI summaries.”
  • Verbi Pro: a summary after every transcript of 200 characters or more, and a free choice of template for recordings that don’t have a summary yet.
  • Once a recording has a summary, it can’t be regenerated or switched to another template.
  • Summaries keep to what was said: owners and due dates appear only when someone stated them, and proposals are kept apart from decisions.
  • The summary is written in the app’s interface language. For very long recordings, it’s based on up to 200,000 characters of the transcript, about three hours of speech.

Frequently asked questions

Can I regenerate a summary with a different template?

No. Once a recording has a summary, it can’t be regenerated or switched to another template.

Why didn’t my recording get a summary?

On the free plan, only your first transcript of 200 characters or more gets an automatic summary. With Pro, a transcript shorter than 200 characters doesn’t get one automatically, but you can generate one.

Which language is the summary in?

The app’s interface language (English, Turkish, German, French or Spanish), whatever language was spoken. See which languages Verbi supports.
